newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks mixed at start, Dow weak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks mixed at start, Dow weak.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were mixed at the start of trading on Wednesday with the Dow coming in for profit-taking after Tuesday's 173-point rally.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 10 points at 6,924 but the Nasdaq Composite rose two to 1,215.
The 30-year long bond was down 5/32 to yield 7.06 percent.
